results.title: This Is Not a Test
results.overview: Sloane and four classmates take cover in Cortege High to escape a world plagued by the infected. As danger relentlessly pounds on the doors, Sloane begins to see the world through the eyes of those who actually want to live and takes matters into her own hands.

results.title: Blast
results.overview: A seemingly ordinary family must unleash their hidden martial arts skills when they clash with a ruthless criminal gang tied to corruption and violence.

results.title: Creampie
results.overview: A story with a creamy twist. Gemma moves in with her boyfriend at a friend’s creampie house, only to uncover the sinful secret behind the town’s most famous creampie business.

results.title: Gandhari
results.overview: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

results.title: Comrade Kalyan
results.overview: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

results.title: Assassination Classroom the Movie: Our Time
results.original_title: 劇場版「暗殺教室」みんなの時間
results.overview: United by a common mission to eliminate their teacher, Koro-sensei, an alien creature with phenomenal strength, join Nagisa and his Class 3-E classmates in brand-new adventures.

results.title: Clown Panic
results.overview: Revisits the bizarre nationwide hysteria of 2016, which began with reports of creepy clowns hiding near woods in South Carolina and quickly spiraled into widespread panic, school lockdowns, and police interventions across the United States. This in-depth documentary features interviews with eyewitnesses, law enforcement officials, cultural commentators, and professional clowns whose livelihoods were impacted by the craze.

results.title: Neglected
results.overview: Detective Shaw is about to retire when he finds out on his last day of work that a serial killer has buried his son alive. He then races against the clock to solve three murders and find his son’s location before he runs out of air.

results.title: Karuppu
results.overview: In a world where justice falters, guardian deity Vettai Karuppu takes the guise of a lawyer to battle a corrupt legal system preying on the powerless.

results.title: The Last Kiss
results.overview: A young woman discovers she can foresee the death of anyone she kisses, and when a vision predicts her crush will die in a murder spree targeting her closest friends, she races to uncover the killer before more lives are lost.

results.title: The Breadwinner
results.overview: After his wife Katie lands a once-in-a-lifetime deal on Shark Tank that takes her on a prolonged business trip - lifelong breadwinner Nate Wilcox now has to fend for his family as a first-time stay-at-home dad.

results.title: Infiltrate
results.overview: In a city overrun by crime, government Agent Lily Chen is forced to choose between her duty and her family when her husband is kidnapped, and she’s blackmailed into assassinating high-level criminals to save him. As she delves deeper into the criminal underworld, Lily’s relentless pursuit of justice unravels a web of corruption, leading to a final, life-altering decision that will change her world forever.

results.title: El Club del Pie Izquierdo
results.overview: A forty-year-old office worker of Mexico City, realizes that he has been trapped in a car and a desk for years. He finds a dance academy, enrolls in reggaeton classes with strict teacher Paulina, and finds renewal. Remake of the Japanese film 'Shall We Dance?'

results.title: Death Whisperer: Saming the Werebeast
results.original_title: ธี่หยด: สมิงเขาขวาง
results.overview: Follows the search for a missing military officer in the jungle of Khao Khwang, where legend says man-eating tiger spirit Saming takes human form in 1960s Thailand.

results.title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
results.original_title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
results.overview: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"

results.title: Office Romance
results.overview: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees. When a new sexy lawyer begins working for her, that policy becomes very tested.

results.title: The Bluff
results.overview: When her tranquil life on a remote island is shattered by the return of her vengeful former captain, a skilled ex-pirate must confront her bloody past and unleash her deadly talents to save her family from a ruthless siege.

results.title: Summer House
results.overview: Selin travels back in time at a summer house and finds herself in her mother's youth, changing her family's fate and rebuilding her own life.

results.title: Her Private Hell
results.overview: When a mysterious mist engulfs a futuristic metropolis, unleashing a deadly and elusive entity, a troubled young woman searches for her father. Her quest collides with an American GI on a harrowing odyssey to rescue his daughter from Hell.

results.title: Invention 13
results.overview: On a cold, windy night, a frustrated pianist encounters strange obstacles while trying to learn  Bach's notoriously intricate Invention 13.
